scrambled_tile_sets.activity_title: Unscramble Operations with Integers Procedure Steps

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Adding negative numbers and turning the result positive (e.g., thinking -7 - 18 = +25).
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Distinguish between addition/subtraction and multiplication. Adding two negatives yields a negative: (-7) + (-18) = -25.

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Confusing division by negative numbers with subtraction.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Treat division as finding the factor: (-36) ÷ (-9) = +4 because (+4) × (-9) = -36.
